description: The file defines a specialized serializer class for handling Exotel media streams over WebSocket, including serialization and deserialization of media frames, DTMF events, and handling of resampling. It is part of a larger communication framework for telephony integration within the Pipecat project.

classes.name: ExotelFrameSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Exotel Media Streams WebSocket protocol, handling conversion between Pipecat frames and Exotel's WebSocket media stream protocol, including audio resampling, DTMF event handling, and connection setup.

methods.name: __init__( self, stream_sid: str, call_sid: Optional[str] = None, params: Optional[InputParams] = None )
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with stream SID, optional call SID, and optional configuration parameters.

methods.name: FrameSerializerType type(self)
methods.description: Returns the serializer type, which is TEXT.

methods.name: setup(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Configures the serializer with pipeline settings based on the StartFrame input.

methods.name: str|bytes|None serialize(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Converts Pipecat frames into WebSocket messages suitable for transmission to Exotel, including handling of media frames and interruption signals.

methods.name: Frame|None deserialize(self, data: str | bytes)
methods.description: Converts incoming WebSocket messages from Exotel into Pipecat frames, handling media, DTMF, and other events.
